assumptions: Drawing units taken as 'mm' ($INSUNITS=4).

Masonry: plan area of legend wall hatches (material from the drawing's legend) and of walls drawn only as paired wall-role lines; hatch voids and column layers are columns and are excluded. Gross wall = hatched area + wall across each tagged opening; openings deducted (W x H x nominal thickness).

IS 1200 (Part 3) brickwork rules (user_config 'brickwork'): is1200_beam_soffit=True; deduct_columns=True; deduct_lintels=True; beam_width_mm=230; lintel_bearing_mm=150. Beam soffit: brick height stops under beams running over the wall; columns: RCC column footprints lying on the masonry are deducted; lintels: (opening width + 2 x bearing) x depth x wall thickness deducted when the lintel size is known.
Half brick = brick whose local thickness <= midpoint of 115 and 230 mm (measured in m2); thicker brick and AAC in m3 at nominal thickness.
Wall height per cell = the smallest user zone / resolved flag covering it, else the default (flagged).

Plaster: wall faces found on the plan raster; internal = face of a roofed space (height = lower of wall and room height); external = outside the roof outline (ground to top of parapet). CPWD: openings <= 0.5 m2 not deducted; 0.5-3 m2 deducted on one face (room side); > 3 m2 both faces, jambs/soffit/sill added.
Ceiling plaster and floor areas = net enclosed roofed area of each space (walls and columns excluded).
Floor finish per room from section finish notes mapped onto the plan along the section line, else the user's finishes; otherwise listed as 'finish not specified' (not payable).
Roof: slab area = area inside parapet outer faces per T.O.S. level; parapet/coping on the centre line of paired parapet lines; terrace treatment = slab - parapet footprint - tank footprint.
Not in drawing (not measured): foundations, excavation, PCC, slab/beam/lintel sizes unless entered, skirting/dado.
